description:
£135 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this beautifully presented three-bedroom student property in the heart of West Jesmond.

Neutrally decorated throughout and furnished with modern furniture, the property offers three well-appointed bedrooms, each featuring a double bed, wardrobe, chest of drawers, desk, chair and bedside table. The spacious open plan kitchen and lounge provide an ideal space for relaxing and socialising, with the kitchen benefiting from a dishwasher and a large fridge freezer. There is also a separate utility area housing a washer dryer, alongside a modern shower room featuring a double shower. Further benefits include an alarm system and a private rear yard.

Ideally located close to West Jesmond Metro Station and the wide range of shops, cafés, bars and restaurants that Jesmond has to offer, this property is perfectly suited to student living.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today!
